title: Eastern State Penitentiary: The Empty Cellblocks

facts: Eastern State Penitentiary opened in Philadelphia in 1829.

hook_first_sentence: Eastern State Penitentiary does not need a ghost to feel wrong.
script: Eastern State Penitentiary does not need a ghost to feel wrong. The prison opened in Philadelphia in 1829, and its long cellblocks were built so one guard could see down the rows. That sounds efficient until you picture the silence. One door. One narrow room. One person left alone with his own thoughts. The shocking part is that this was not a movie set. It was a real system people believed would reform prisoners. Today, when a corridor goes quiet there, the fear comes from the truth: the walls remember a real kind of isolation.
retention_hook: Turns a real prison design into the source of dread.
why_it_worked: Grounds horror in real confinement history and concrete visuals.
